name: band
breaks_up: a band of individual practitioners, each doing their own thing, who show and publish together in episodes
left_out: Artists and art spaces: the people of a band in this syntax practise something other than art, and its spaces are not art spaces. It also leaves out a list of who made which work, an open call, and money.
note: Read from Bairang's own documents on 13 November 2026 (his words that day: "bairang is a kind of thing which has syntax - it is example"). Bairang is the band described in it.

element_types.name: curator
element_types.description: The person who starts the band, fixes each episode's question and writes every invitation.

elements.name: one of the people
elements.description: the curator also makes a work for the episode, unsigned like the rest

elements.name: outside the band
elements.description: the curator invites and shows, and makes no work

element_types.name: people
element_types.description: Individual practitioners, each doing their own thing. They practise something other than art.

elements.name: research
elements.description: someone whose practice is finding things out

elements.name: writing
elements.description: someone whose practice is writing

elements.name: sound
elements.description: someone who makes sound

elements.name: making
elements.description: someone who makes things with their hands or with machines

elements.name: teaching
elements.description: someone whose practice is teaching

elements.name: code
elements.description: someone who writes code

element_types.name: question
element_types.description: The provocation each invitation carries for an episode. Each person makes one work in answer to it.

element_types.name: way in
element_types.description: How a person comes into an episode. There is no open call.

elements.name: invitation
elements.description: the curator writes to the person and asks for one work in answer to the question

elements.name: proposing yourself
elements.description: a person or a space proposes itself, to be considered for being invited to pitch

elements.name: a pitch under a token
elements.description: the invited person pitches under a token, with no name, so the pitch is read without knowing whose it is

element_types.name: space
element_types.description: Where an episode is shown. The curator writes to spaces and asks what they could offer, and invites them to apply or pitch.

elements.description: a library

elements.description: a bookshop

elements.description: a school

elements.description: a makerspace

elements.name: print shop
elements.description: a print shop

elements.name: research centre
elements.description: a research centre

element_types.name: signing
element_types.description: Whether a work carries its maker's name.

elements.name: unsigned
elements.description: no work carries its maker's name; a ledger keeps which token is whose, closed for ten years, and each maker can claim their work when they choose, or never

elements.name: signed
elements.description: each work carries its maker's name

element_types.name: episode
element_types.description: One round of the band: one question, its works, shown together.

elements.name: shown in a space
elements.description: the works are shown together, for real, in the space

elements.name: published online
elements.description: the works are published together online
